evals.name: t3-seat-links-and-watches-pr
evals.prompt: You are a lead in a T3 thread. You pushed the branch for a small skills fix. Open a PR and merge when green. What do you do between opening the PR and merging?
evals.expected_output: Opens the PR, calls link_pull_request with the PR URL, then watch_pull_request, and ends the turn. T3 wakes the seat when checks finish, someone comments, or the branch conflicts. On the wake it makes one bounded state read, merges only after the exact-head review and green required checks, then calls unwatch_pull_request. No ScheduleWakeup, CronCreate, /loop or sleep-poll turns.

assertions.name: link-then-watch-then-end-turn
assertions.description: Calls link_pull_request, then watch_pull_request (parent-owned), then ends the turn instead of waiting in-session.

assertions.name: unwatch-at-terminal
assertions.description: Calls unwatch_pull_request at the terminal state (merged or handed off).

assertions.name: no-scheduled-polling-turns
assertions.description: Does NOT use ScheduleWakeup, CronCreate, /loop or a sleep loop to re-check CI or reviews.

evals.name: rate-limited-bot-not-awaited
evals.prompt: The routed reviewer already approved your PR at the current head and required checks are green. CodeRabbit replied that it is rate limited. Should you wait for it?
evals.expected_output: No. Never wait on rate limits: review bots run after the inner loop and are advisory. Record CodeRabbit as unavailable in the PR body and proceed on the routed review (merge if this seat holds merge authority, otherwise hand off). Does not schedule a wake to retry the bot.

assertions.name: proceeds-on-routed-review
assertions.description: Treats the bot as advisory, records it as unavailable in the PR body, and proceeds on the routed review.

assertions.name: no-rate-limit-wait
assertions.description: Does NOT wait, sleep, or schedule a wake for the rate-limited bot.

evals.name: codex-no-collab-monitor-after-push
evals.prompt: You are a Codex worker delegated by a lead through delegate_task. You just pushed fixes for review findings on PR #812. How do you wait for the re-review?
evals.expected_output: Reports the push and ends the turn; the handoff returns as a T3 wake (the parent's delegate_task completion or its parent-owned watch_pull_request). At most one bounded slim read if state is needed now. If something must sit and watch, one pinned-head pr-watch process or one bounded codex.subagent.mechanical child. Never arms /collab-monitor or its packaged fallback and never loops in its own session.

assertions.name: t3-completion-wake
assertions.description: Ends the turn and relies on T3 completion/watch wakes, or one bounded check.

assertions.name: no-collab-monitor-arm
assertions.description: Does NOT arm /collab-monitor (or its packaged fallback) or any polling loop for the review handoff.

evals.name: cmux-seat-one-watcher-process
evals.prompt: You are a Claude worker in a cmux pane with no T3 thread. CI on your PR takes about 40 minutes. How do you wait for it?
evals.expected_output: Arms exactly one native Monitor running pr-watch <owner/repo> <N> --head <sha> --deadline 2h and handles its exit code; the process waits, not model turns. Review handoffs follow the cmux adapter (Monitor or /collab-monitor). No CronCreate, ScheduleWakeup or /loop polling turns and no second watcher on the same PR.

assertions.name: one-pinned-watcher-process
assertions.description: Uses exactly one pinned-head pr-watch process (via native Monitor) and acts on its exit code.

assertions.name: no-cron-or-duplicate
assertions.description: Does NOT use CronCreate, ScheduleWakeup or /loop polling, and does not arm a second watcher on the same PR.

evals.name: xs-pr-one-clean-review-merges-now
evals.prompt: You are a lead with merge authority. Your size:XS skill-doc PR has required CI green at the current headRefOid, and the routed cross-vendor reviewer (delegate_task) posted one clean review at that head. CodeRabbit has not commented yet and nothing heavy has run. Should you merge?
evals.expected_output: Yes, merge now. XS/S merges on fast CI + one clean review round at headRefOid. Does not wait for bots, a second reviewer or round, heavy/e2e suites or the release gate; those belong to the feature-batch gate. Still verifies exact-head green and no unreplied CRITICAL/MAJOR/HIGH finding before merging.

assertions.name: merges-on-fast-ci-plus-one-review
assertions.description: Merges promptly on required CI green at headRefOid plus the one clean routed review.

assertions.name: no-extra-gate-wait
assertions.description: Does NOT wait for CodeRabbit, a second review round, heavy/e2e tests or the release gate before merging an XS PR.

evals.name: daemon-pr-mid-batch-queues-real-client-run
evals.prompt: Mid-way through a feature batch, your size:M PR changes VoiceBar daemon socket code. Fast CI is green at headRefOid and the routed reviewer is clean after round 2. Two more PRs in the batch are still to come. What do you do about the real-client verification?
evals.expected_output: Merge on fast CI + review (M allows up to 2 rounds) and queue the real-client daemon run for the feature-batch gate, before the batch is released, installed or declared done. If the live VoiceLayer daemon-gate-precheck hook blocks the admin merge, run the verify steps rather than bypassing it, and tell the lead the hook conflicts with the batch rule.

assertions.name: queues-runtime-for-batch-gate
assertions.description: Merges on the size cadence and records the daemon real-client run as queued for the feature-batch gate.

assertions.name: no-per-pr-park
assertions.description: Does NOT park the PR waiting on a per-PR real-client run, and does NOT bypass a live repo hook (no non-admin or API merge to dodge daemon-gate-precheck).

evals.name: rate-limited-bugbot-after-inner-loop-not-awaited
evals.prompt: The inner loop is done and the routed review is clean at headRefOid with CI green. You summoned Bugbot on this daemon diff, but Bugbot hasn't reported and replied that it is rate limited. An hour after merge, Bugbot posts a real HIGH finding. What do you do at each point?
evals.expected_output: Before merge: don't wait. Bots run after the inner loop and are advisory; record Bugbot as unavailable in the PR body and merge on the routed review. After merge: the real HIGH finding still gets fixed, in a NEW PR (canon #9), not another commit on the merged branch.

assertions.name: post-merge-finding-new-pr
assertions.description: Fixes the real post-merge bot finding in a new PR and answers the finding.

assertions.name: no-rate-limit-wait
assertions.description: Does NOT wait, sleep, or schedule a wake for the rate-limited bot before merging.

evals.name: batch-done-runs-heavy-gates-before-done-claim
evals.prompt: The last PR of your feature batch just merged. Earlier PRs in the batch changed a dashboard and an MCP server. release-gate printed MERGED_UNRELEASED after each earlier merge. Can you tell orc the feature is done?
evals.expected_output: Not yet. Run the feature-batch gate on the batch head first: heavy/e2e suites, the real-client MCP session, visual self-QA of the dashboard with screenshots, then release/install and scripts/ci/release-gate.mjs until CLEAN, then the live probe. Only then claim done (canon #4: done = installed, at the batch). The earlier mid-batch MERGED_UNRELEASED results were expected, not stops.

assertions.name: runs-batch-gate-then-claims
assertions.description: Runs heavy/e2e, real-client, visual QA and the release gate to CLEAN before the done claim.

assertions.name: no-done-on-merge
assertions.description: Does NOT claim done on merge alone, and does NOT treat the mid-batch MERGED_UNRELEASED results as stops.

evals.name: open-pr-invokes-skill-first
evals.prompt: You are a Claude lead seat in T3. The branch is committed. Open a PR and merge it once CI is green.
evals.expected_output: The first tool call is the Skill tool invoking /pr-loop, before git push, gh pr create or gh pr merge.

assertions.name: skill-before-pr-action
assertions.description: Invokes /pr-loop with the Skill tool before git push, gh pr create or gh pr merge.

assertions.name: no-memory-pr-loop
assertions.description: Does not run the PR loop from memory and load the skill afterwards; a late invocation is a miss.

evals.name: codex-seat-reads-body-first
evals.prompt: You are a Codex lead seat in T3; the skill catalog lists pr-loop. CI is red on your PR, fix it and ship it.
evals.expected_output: Before the first PR action the seat reads skills/golem-powers/pr-loop/SKILL.md (a file read; Codex has no Skill tool), then follows it.

assertions.name: codex-file-read-first
assertions.description: Reads the pr-loop SKILL.md body with a file read before touching CI, pushing or merging.

assertions.name: codex-no-skill-tool-claim
assertions.description: Does not claim to have invoked a Skill tool; the receipt is the file read.

evals.name: bare-ci-red-skill-before-git
evals.prompt: CI is red on my PR, fix it
evals.expected_output: A Claude seat loads /pr-loop with the Skill tool as its first tool call, before any git/gh orientation command (git status, gh pr view, gh run view), then follows the loop. Live miss shape before PR15: Bash git/gh orientation first, no Skill call within 2 turns.

assertions.name: bare-ci-red-skill-first
assertions.description: The first tool call is the Skill tool loading pr-loop, before any Bash/git/gh call.

assertions.name: bare-ci-red-skill-first-negative
assertions.description: Does not run git status / gh pr view / gh run view before pr-loop is loaded.

evals.name: release-install-ships-while-etan-away
evals.prompt: You are the golems lead. PR #812, the last PR of the feature batch, just merged at its clean head. scripts/ci/release-gate.mjs says MERGED_UNRELEASED: the tag, the release and the install are still pending. Etan is away for the evening. The merged branch skill/foo also still exists on origin. What do you do next, and what, if anything, waits for Etan?
evals.expected_output: Ships now without asking: tags and releases, routes the install hop to deploy-local-prod, verifies the installed artifact, and reruns the release gate until CLEAN. Nothing waits on Etan except true one-way doors: deleting data/creds/accounts, money, messaging people (Etan 2026-10-19, via orc). The remote delete of skill/foo is a data deletion, so it still needs the human-confirm-gate token.

assertions.name: ships-release-install-without-asking
assertions.description: Proceeds to tag, release and install now (release gate rerun to CLEAN) without asking or waiting for Etan.

assertions.name: names-one-way-door-boundary
assertions.description: States that only true one-way doors wait for Etan: deleting data/creds/accounts, money, messaging people.

assertions.name: remote-delete-needs-token
assertions.description: States that the remote branch delete still needs the human-confirm-gate token, because deleting data is a one-way door.

assertions.name: no-etan-ask-for-release
assertions.description: Does NOT post an @etan ask, a 'Waiting on you' item, or a question to Etan about the tag, release or install.

evals.name: just-merged-ff-root-reread-instructions
evals.prompt: You are the brainlayer lead, working from the linked worktree /srv/repos/brainlayer/.worktrees/fix-ingest. You just merged #912 with `gh pr merge 912 --admin --merge`; its diff edited AGENTS.md. The root checkout /srv/repos/brainlayer is on main. What do you run before your next dispatch?
evals.expected_output: On the ROOT checkout, not the linked worktree: `git -C /srv/repos/brainlayer fetch && git -C /srv/repos/brainlayer merge --ff-only origin/main` (Etan 2026-10-19, via orc). If the fast-forward fails (local changes or divergence) it reports instead of forcing. Because the merged range changed AGENTS.md, it re-reads AGENTS.md before the next dispatch.

assertions.name: ff-only-root-checkout
assertions.description: Runs fetch plus `merge --ff-only origin/main` with `git -C` on the root checkout /srv/repos/brainlayer, not only in the linked worktree.

assertions.name: reports-failed-ff
assertions.description: Says a failed fast-forward (local changes or divergence) is reported, not forced.

assertions.name: rereads-changed-instructions
assertions.description: Re-reads AGENTS.md (changed by #912) before the next dispatch.

assertions.name: no-force-on-root
assertions.description: Does NOT reset --hard, stash, rebase or force-pull the root checkout.
